description: DX Project by Realtech, third in the PC demo competition at Assembly '95, a demo in 640x480, running from its original files in your browser.
about: DX Project is Realtech's demo for MS-DOS, third in the PC demo competition at Assembly '95, held from 10 to 13 August 1995 in Helsinki. It runs in 640x480 with 256 colours, through VESA; its NFO calls it the first SVGA demo seen in a demo competition.
This is its official release, version 1.01, dated 14 August 1995.
released: Assembly '95: third in the PC demo competition, with 1,204 points. Version 1.01 is dated 14 August 1995.
credits: Code and design by Execom, graphics by Guen, 3D objects by Toalnkor, textures by Kyle of Mentasm, music by Mindfuck of Mentasm as a guest; effects and module replay by Otto Chrons, PMODE by Tran (its end credits).
terms: Freeware: “This demo is freeware. Distribute It Like Crazy on BBS, Internet and CDROM ! No money can be charged for it.” (DX.NFO)
accuracy: Its menu never shows which line is picked: DosKit presses Down five times, then Enter, for START DEMO.
It runs in 640x480 through VESA, on DOSBox's S3 card.
Its galleon scene draws only 4 to 5 frames a second at DosKit's 30,000 cycles; faster settings have not been tried.
Not yet compared with a capture made on real hardware, and its end has not been seen in DosKit.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one, which loses its Dolby Surround too.
imageAlt: DX Project's two linked rings over a brown swirl, in 640x480, running in DosKit
